title: Collective Plate: pick the composition
question: Same world, three first viewports. Lock the one to build, or steer: what should carry forward, what feels false to the world.

options.label: A. The signed plate
options.lineage: Headline column beside one framed work
options.thesis: The Postgres workspace hangs as a single signed plate; the headline stands beside it in cobalt.
options.viewport: Symbol nav; cobalt condensed headline left with statement and two actions; the capture framed right with symbols hovering off its corners and the mark signed inside; a cobalt band announces Plate 02 · Redis at the fold.
options.risk: The classic split hero: the world carries it, the topology does not.

options.label: B. The gallery wall
options.lineage: One title band, one wall-sized work
options.thesis: The headline is a cobalt title band; the workspace fills the wall beneath, switched by symbol tabs.
options.viewport: Nav; a full-width cobalt band with the one-line headline, statement and lemon action; three plate tabs (the active one hovers); the SQL workspace at near full width with symbols breaking the frame.
options.risk: Most product on screen, least room for the collective's play; scrolling must deliver the other plates.

options.label: C. The collective wall
options.lineage: A rail and four plates at once
options.thesis: A cobalt rail signs the wall; four plates in one grid show the same symbols reused by three engines.
options.viewport: Left rail with symbol nav and download; a 2x2 of plates: headline plate, Postgres, Redis on magenta, OpenSearch on lemon, each capture signed and ticketed.
options.risk: Densest and loudest; the headline is smaller and each capture is a crop.
